purpose: Machine-readable summary of the BWCA sulfide-mine cascade simulation. One file, one read, full context for any AI agent.
one_line_finding: Value exits the state as ore, revenue, and dividends within 20 years. Cost stays as AMD, mercury, community collapse, and treaty liability for centuries. The measurement system that approved it is structurally blind to the majority of the actual cost.

TITLE.node: Mineral lease + CRA reversal of PLO 7917
TITLE.description: Legal access to the ore body. The lease is the title node — without it, no extraction occurs. PLO 7917 was the constraint; CRA vote removed it.

SURPLUS.node: Ore revenue — leaves state as concentrate + profit
SURPLUS.description: Cu-Ni concentrate shipped to smelter (Chile/Asia). Revenue to Antofagasta (Santiago). Dividends to Luksic family + global shareholders. Payroll taxes are the only surplus that touches Minnesota, and they end when the mine closes.

POWER.node: Corporate + political capital to maintain access
POWER.description: Mining revenue funds lobbying, campaign contributions, and industry-association political operations. This capital maintains the political conditions that keep the lease active and resist regulatory constraint.

ENFORCE.node: CRA vote + regulatory capture + EA limitations
ENFORCE.description: The CRA mechanism bypasses environmental analysis. The EA process is bounded by stationarity assumptions (climate_boundary.py). The enforcement node prevents the constraint signal (AMD, treaty violation, community collapse) from reaching the decision layer.

CONSTRAINT.node: Physics — AMD thermodynamics, treaty law, community capacity
CONSTRAINT.description: The external constraint that the loop suppresses. delta-G < 0 for sulfide oxidation (physics). Treaty rights are constitutionally protected (law). Community collapse is self-reinforcing once triggered (secondary effects). None of these constraints can be lobbied, bought, or voted away. They operate on the physical substrate, not the political one.
CONSTRAINT.drives: Injects perturbation into ENFORCE when buffer breaks

falsifiable_claims.claim: The engineering design basis for Twin Metals' mitigation systems uses current, not historical, climate data for this specific watershed.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED. Project documents long predate current downscaled products; no public update disclosed.

falsifiable_claims.claim: Closed-loop water systems can meet their water balance in NE Minnesota under projected drier summers and flash-drought conditions.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED. No regional precedent under current drought regime.

falsifiable_claims.claim: Vegetated closure covers will persist under projected evapotranspiration and drought conditions for >100 yr.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED. Closure precedents are almost entirely from prior climate regime.

falsifiable_claims.claim: Wildfire x tailings interaction has been modeled in the project's risk assessment.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED. Standard practice in 2010-2020 era EAs did not include this explicitly.

falsifiable_claims.claim: Design storms used for tailings and stormwater sizing reflect post-2000 mega-rain event frequency.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED GENERALLY. MN has some of the best rain-gauge data in the country, and it shows clear non-stationarity not reflected in typical older engineering designs.

falsifiable_claims.claim: Sulfate discharge limits and wild rice protection thresholds are valid under warmer, more-stratified receiving waters.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED. Threshold was empirically derived under cooler regime; mercury methylation increases with both T and sulfate.

falsifiable_claims.claim: Post-closure bond sizing accounts for compound-hazard climate risk (wildfire + megarain + drought + grid event) over 500+ yr.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED. Industry-standard bonds do not integrate compound climate hazards over multi-century timescales.

falsifiable_claims.claim: The boreal forest context in which the closure plan is written will persist through the post-closure liability window.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED. Frelich and UMN CAP project prairie/forest boundary moves ~300 miles NE by end of century under current trajectories.

falsifiable_claims.claim: The mitigation dependency stack (grid, reagents, water, skilled labor) is resilient to the same climate hazards that threaten the site.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED. None of these dependencies are climate-hardened at the site level. When a regional crisis hits, the mitigation stack loses its inputs in the same event that stresses the containment.

falsifiable_claims.claim: The Senate vote of 2026-04-16, which eliminated PLO 7917 via the CRA, considered climate boundary-condition changes to the underlying risk assessment.
falsifiable_claims.state: UNFALSIFIED. The CRA mechanism explicitly bypasses environmental analysis. No climate update was required or produced.

food_analogs.notes: Critical case: indigenous communities may NOT out-migrate even under extreme contamination because land is identity, not property. Displacement is expressed as health and cultural loss, not departure. This means the BWCA model's migration_cap of 0.65 may OVERESTIMATE departure for tribal populations while UNDERESTIMATING total harm.

food_analogs.contaminant: Sulfate from mining and industrial discharge
food_analogs.notes: Direct analog to BWCA model: sulfate from copper- nickel mining is the specific threat. 10 mg/L threshold is the same value used in the model's SULFATE_TOXIC_MG_L constant.

indigenous_food_insecurity.source: PMC 2021 (First Nations food insecurity, 92 communities); medRxiv 2022 / Wiley 2024 (contaminated sites scoping review); BMC Public Health 2023 (colonization impacts on food systems)
indigenous_food_insecurity.key_finding: 29% of federal contaminated sites sit on 0.5% of the land mass. Food insecurity 48-100% on affected reserves. Environmental contamination and government food-harvest restrictions compound to destroy subsistence base.

indigenous_compounding.description: Indigenous displacement from environmental contamination is NEVER a single-cause event. It layers on top of forced relocation (reserve system, residential schools), economic exclusion, and ongoing jurisdictional conflicts. Each layer reduces capacity to resist the next.
layer_sequence: 5. Economic collapse from loss of subsistence + tourism
7. Youth out-migration from lack of economic base
indigenous_compounding.bwca_specific: Bois Forte (3,400), Grand Portage (1,100), Fond du Lac (4,200) hold 1854 Treaty usufructuary rights to harvest manoomin in the BWCA watershed. Sulfate contamination above 10 mg/L destroys the resource the treaty protects. This is not property damage — it is a treaty violation and a destruction of identity-level cultural practice (see calibration/architecture_mismatch.py: identity_level encoding cannot be replaced by compensation).
indigenous_compounding.source: 1854 Treaty Authority; MN Indian Affairs; Lancet Planetary Health 2020 (Grassy Narrows mortality); Cultural Survival Quarterly (Grassy Narrows 60-yr legacy)

value_leaves_state.note: Ore, revenue, dividends, expertise all exit MN. Only payroll taxes stay, and only for 20 yr.

cost_stays_in_state.note: AMD, Hg, community collapse, treaty liability, perpetual treatment all stay. Permanently.

time_asymmetry.note: 20-yr extraction window vs centuries-to-millennia cost window. Ratio > 50:1.

corporate_solvency_at_closure.note: Historical pattern: hardrock mining companies are insolvent at closure. Liability transfers to public.

regulatory_capture_completeness.note: CRA bypasses environmental analysis entirely. No mechanism to require updated risk assessment.

community_consent.note: MCT declined task force. 1854 Treaty Authority issued own report. CRA overrides local opposition.

wealth_consolidation_direction.note: Luksic family (~$25B net worth) captures value; shallow-well homeowners (~$29k median income) absorb cost.

measurement_system_bias.note: EA measures projected impacts against stationarity assumptions. Does not measure: secondary loops, commercial cascade, cultural knowledge loss, epigenetic transmission, peatland CH4, compound hazards. The measurement system is structurally blind to the majority of the actual cost.

reversibility.note: Every outflow is irreversible. Ore cannot be un-mined. AMD cannot be stopped. Cultural knowledge cannot be retrained. Ecosystem services cannot be re-purchased. Treaty rights cannot be un-violated.

extraction_pattern_match.note: TITLE->SURPLUS->POWER->ENFORCE->TITLE loop is complete and self-reinforcing. Matches substrate_audit.CAUSAL_LOOP exactly. The BWCA mine is a specific instance of the general extraction topology the repo already describes.

stationarity_failure.note: Design inputs from a climate regime that no longer applies.

compound_hazard_neglect.note: Wildfire x megarain x drought x grid-outage are correlated, not independent.

wildfire_tailings_coupling.note: Documented in analog watersheds; not assessed in Twin Metals EA.

megarain_design_storm_obsolescence.note: 4x mega-rain increase since 2000; older IDF curves drive undersized systems.

biome_transition_context.note: Closure plan implicitly assumes boreal persistence.

mercury_methylation_nonlinearity.note: Warmer + stratified + sulfate = more MeHg per unit sulfate.

post_closure_window_vs_climate.note: 500-10,000 yr liability window spans entire projected climate transition.

base_rate_validity.note: Every probabilistic regulatory claim is a conditional probability on obsolete climate.

CRA_bypass_of_climate_analysis.note: No mechanism in the CRA to require updated analysis; none was performed.
